name: Inngest OG social card by inngest.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a single saturated orange field with a fine grain overlay that keeps the flat colour from feeling sterile. The logo lockup sits top-left and a left-aligned two-line headline owns the middle of the frame: the first line is solid white bold sans, the second line repeats at identical size but in hollow outline type — hierarchy achieved through fill treatment rather than scale or a second colour. The bottom third is deliberately empty, letting the type, colour and texture do all the work.
